title: Norm Dwyer
description: "The Imperial AT-ATs and Rebel Snowspeeders hold particular interest for me," explains Norm Dwyer, "perhaps because of their David and Goliath relationship." Dwyer's comic book debut occurred in 1987, when he created and drew Malibu's flagship title LIBBY ELLIS. Since then, he's worked on numerous titles for a variety of publishers. His latest work is the ground-breaking computer generated comic book DONNA MATRIX from Reactor's Digital Comics line. Currently Dwyer is developing robustly detailed interactive CD-ROM computer games at Reactor.
